description: This file defines the VoiceWakeForwarder utility, providing functions for forwarding voice recognition transcripts with contextual information, error handling, and connection checks. It includes an enum for error types, a structure for options, and functions to send data through a gateway connection.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Generates a contextual transcript message including machine name info.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Sends the transcript to a gateway connection with specified options, returns success or failure result.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connection status to the gateway, returning success or failure.
